evals.prompt: Using our production standards for verify-and-rollback, review our architecture and provide a step-by-step read-only assessment and implementation plan (Day-2 post-deployment readiness verification, CloudWatch alarm and log triage, CloudFormation failure root-cause analysis, and safe stack or).
